images.alt: Inference is seeing the world with your own eyes; belief is trusting someone else’s perspective.
Where belief locks the door, inference leaves it open just enough for new ideas to walk in.
It’s easier to believe than to think.
The question isn’t “who am I?” The real question is: “who do I choose to be next?”
You attract what you believe not what you want.
The truth is inferred not believed.
The less you cling to what you “know”, the more space you create for what you “don’t know”.
The moment you shift from expectation to acceptance is the moment you free yourself from the cycle of disappointment
Belief gives you directions, Inference shows you the path
Curiosity is your guide and Patience is your best friend
